Within harnessed AI to generatively design complex forms that could then be 3D printed; the team made breakthroughs in lightweight aircraft components, customised running shoes, and orthopaedic implants.
Co-founded Digital Forming to spearhead mass customisation of consumer products, raising seed investment from EOS, a 3D printing industry leader.
Heads up Grow, an independent company spun out of Within, specialising in distributed manufacturing.

AI Music is an acqui-hired company based in London, founded in 2016 by Siavash Mahdavi, Inderjit Birdee and Andy Khavand, providing AI-based music creation solutions. It raised $7.16M over 2 rounds from 4 investors, valued at £17.6M.
Co-Founder & CEO at Ossia Studio alongside Andy Khavand and Inderjit Birdee.
